steps.name: Elena the Scholar
steps.objective: Talk to [Usher], then find [Elena] in "Coral City".

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: Oh, adventurer!

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: You've come to deal with the problem in Coral City!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard something serious had happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've come to find out what it is. Did you say Coral City? I've never heard of it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since you mentioned it the moment you saw me, I assume that's where the trouble is.

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: Exactly. Coral City is an underwater city that was destroyed in ancient times.

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: But recently, the entire city suddenly came back to life.

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: A powerful barrier surrounds the whole city and blocks everything, so we can't enter at the moment.

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: For better or worse, we've also heard that the barrier is weakening... It's complicated.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So the problem is an underwater civilization that suddenly returned?

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: Yes. I'm worried because reports suggest that its inhabitants aren't in their right minds.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: You should hear from an expert who knows more than I do.

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: The historian Elena should be there. She's the only person who has managed to get inside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? What's a historian doing there?

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: She may have been able to enter because she's one of the few remaining descendants of ancient Coral City's people.

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: She wanted to learn more about her roots, so she became a historian specializing in Coral City.

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: Ask Elena about the city. What she knows should help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll go right away.

steps.name: A Fallen Ancient Kingdom
steps.objective: Talk to [Elena], then defeat [Hermit Crab Warriors]. Report to [Elena] in "Coral City" afterward.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Who are you? How did you get in here? Not just anyone can enter this place... Wait, are you...

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: The one Usher, Mari, and so many others have been talking about...

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: The adventurer traveling the world in search of a hero named Iris... right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's me. And now I'm here to hear what you know, Elena, so I can deal with Coral City's problems.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why has a civilization that was destroyed long ago suddenly reappeared?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have a feeling it might be connected to another problem I know about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Though I can't tell you the details...

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Does it have something to do with that hero, Iris?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Judging by your expression, I think it does.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: You seem to have come to learn about Coral City, so I should tell you what I know.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Records say that Coral City, once a beautiful underwater city, was destroyed by an undersea volcano.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An undersea volcano... D-doesn't that mean we're in danger here too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even if it doesn't happen right away, it could erupt again...

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: From what I've learned, the undersea volcano isn't expected to erupt anytime soon. No, that's not the issue right now...

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Usher and Mari trust you, so I will too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You really trust those two.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Of course. I know them both very well.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: So what are you going to do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure yet. That's what I need to find out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I should gather information, as always.)

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: You're back already?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You really are skeptical.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: That's impossible. You went in and came back so easily...

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: As a descendant, I'm not in much danger, but it should have been difficult for an outsider like you...

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: You really are extraordinary.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Actually, why did someone this extraordinary only arrive now...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something you want, isn't there? All this praise...

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: W-well...

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: You see...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You want help with your research, and any information I find about ruins or artifacts... something like that?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Yes, exactly.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: It's embarrassing to have you see right through me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hehehe. We can discuss the details later. I need to go somewhere first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I still don't have a clear idea of what I should do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please wait here. I'll be back soon.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: You really will come back, won't you?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: If you just leave me here, I might curse you!!

steps.name: The Decision to Strike
steps.objective: Talk to [Mari], then find [Elena] in "Coral City".

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: Magical communication with Lumen in the East Land?

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: That will be easy enough if you can give me the communication code.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here. I was given this, so I'll pass it to you.

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: Ah, yes, this is it. One moment. I'll connect you.

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: Hmm, let's see... Ah, there we go.

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: You're connected!

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Hm? Ah, it's you, adventurer.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Have you reached Atlantis already?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Thanks to you, I arrived safely. Now, about what's happened here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I report on Coral City.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: As I mentioned before, similar things are happening all over the world.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Lady Iris's incomplete awakening has disrupted part of the balance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Her incomplete awakening...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: They say the world has certain laws that maintain its balance. The existence of gods is one of them...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Since Lady Iris, who is to replace the goddess Seres, is so unstable, the natural course of things has become distorted.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Something reappearing across space and time should be utterly impossible.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Until Lady Iris awakens properly, these side effects of the broken balance will keep happening.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh... Even hearing the explanation is frustrating. What can I do?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I feel sorry for the people of Coral City, who have returned as restless spirits, but...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You must defeat them all while the barrier is still holding, just as you have always done.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It's unfortunate, but that's the best thing you can do right now.

steps.name: About Coral City
steps.objective: Talk to [Elena], then defeat [Coral Army Crayfish Soldiers]. Report to [Elena] in "Coral City" afterward.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Have you decided? You're going to help me, right?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Oh, no... I mean, would it be all right if I helped you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think we need to stop Coral City's inhabitants from getting outside the barrier.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They were brought back in the state they were in just before death, so I've been told they'll remain confused and out of control.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We have no choice but to defeat them all.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: (Elena stares blankly for a long time, seemingly in deep shock.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right? Are you all right? Come back to your senses!

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: N-no, I'm fine! I'm really fine...

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Perhaps that would be best for everyone. But can you really take on so many people?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can. It's what I've been doing all along.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since there are so many of them, I think it would be best to strike quickly and pull back.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Even so, you're taking on an entire country... Aren't you treating this a little too lightly?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It'll be fine. Please help me, then. How can you help?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I can tell you about the routes through the city.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I can give you information about its inhabitants too.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Like the sacred beast Leviathan, or King Ocellino, who was revered as a sea god at the time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Listen carefully. Once you enter Coral City, the first thing you need to do is...

steps.name: War Is a Race Against Time!
steps.objective: Talk to [Elena], then defeat the [Sawshark-Armored Coral Dragon]. Report to [Elena] in "Coral City" afterward.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: First, you must head to Song of the Coral.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: To get there, you'll need to defeat those blocking the way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You seem to know everything about this area.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: This is what I've always done.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, then who should I take on?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: The coral dragons.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Coral dragons...

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: It's an area where traces of coral dragons wearing sawshark gloves were often found.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: There are probably plenty of coral dragons there now.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Once you pass that area, you can enter Song of the Coral directly. But be careful, all right?

steps.name: Leviathan, the Divine Beast
steps.objective: Talk to [Elena], then defeat [Leviathan] in the "Song of the Coral". Report to [Elena] in "Coral City" afterward.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Now go inside Song of the Coral and face the Leviathans.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: There will be many spirits of the city's people inside too, so you must be extremely careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of place is Song of the Coral?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: It's a very beautiful, mysterious place.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Corals glowing in every color brush against one another and create beautiful harmonies.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: In ancient times, they say Leviathan would fall asleep to those harmonies as a lullaby.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: You can still hear the coral singing, but don't listen too closely.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: The sound carries the energy of death now, so it could be dangerous.

steps.name: King of the Dead
steps.objective: Talk to [Elena], then defeat [Ocellino] in "Twin Cave" and find [Mari].

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Now head to Twinkive.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Twinkive was a place the king and the citizens often visited.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Somewhere the king and ordinary citizens went together? That couldn't have been easy to arrange.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Ocellino, Coral City's last king, was deeply attached to the place.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: He believed that all living beings could become friends.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: He even invited fishermen to visit Coral City.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a lovely story.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Blessed by a god, he gained authority over the sea and was revered as a sea god himself.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Twinkive is where you'll find King Ocellino.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I think that's all I can tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, that's plenty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go and see the rest for myself. I'll be back soon, so don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: You're back. I should use the same code as before, right?

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: All right, just a moment.

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: Connection complete!

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It's you, adventurer.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Have you completed the mission?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I defeated the sacred beast and the one they called the king... but some troops are still left.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought taking out the leaders first would do it.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Then eliminate all the remaining troops as well. After that, get some rest.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: We don't know what might happen in other regions.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: If anything serious comes up, I'll let you know immediately.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, so I'm on standby?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Well, something like that, I suppose.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Keep up the good work.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I have an urgent meeting now, so I'll have to end the call here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. You're working hard too, Yuran.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You're having a much harder time than I am.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: All because you ended up with the wrong god...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Oh, nothing.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'll be going, then.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Um, excuse me... Is your work finished?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are still some remaining troops to deal with, but I'd say it's almost done.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Then it's time for you to keep your promise!

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Right? You will keep it, won't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do? I'm rather busy...

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: (Elena looks as though she's about to cry.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A-all right. What do you need?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Eee! You're the best, adventurer!

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I knew you'd keep your promise!

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Just bring me artifacts from Coral City so I can continue my research.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's all, I can do it anytime.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Thank you. I'll be counting on you from now on.
